items.text: Malik Nabers in first game since 9/28/25 ACL+meniscus: 36/69 snaps (52%), 24/34 routes (71%), 9 targets (31% share), 6-69-0; emerged healthy.
items.why: First game back post-ACL/meniscus; high route/target share despite snap ramp.
items.implication: Start everywhere; healthy exit supports full role ROS.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers left early with hamstring not considered serious; day-to-day, MRI upcoming; would have returned if playoff game.
items.why: Hamstring exit but not serious per sources.
items.implication: Monitor practice; likely play Week 2 or close.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Ladd McConkey (chest) left early; significant skill injuries include McConkey.
items.why: Chest injury exit after strong start.
items.implication: Monitor practice Week 2; high priority status.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE; risk/reward RB2 but wouldn't make active if worried about injury. Starting him everywhere I have him (some risk, it's the Cardinals).
Patriots WR AJ Brown will not need surgery on high ankle sprain but sidelined 4 to 6 weeks.
items.implication: IR candidate or multi-week sit; stash if deep.

items.text: After meniscus trim Tuesday, Raiders believe realistic chance Brock Bowers misses only one game and returns Week 2 at Chargers; see how he feels this week.
items.implication: Hold; possible Week 2 return limits long absence.

items.text: Surprised Travis Etienne didn't dominate more with Kamara (knee) out. Snaps: Etienne 53, Kendre Miller 26, CJ Donaldson 15. Routes: Etienne 24, Donaldson 7, Kendre 5. Opps: Etienne 18, Kendre 9, Donaldson 4.
items.implication: Etienne lead but not bellcow; Miller handcuff viable.
items.opportunity: Etienne 53 snaps/18 opps lead; Miller 9 opps.

items.text: Dalton Kincaid finally appears over PCL; 42/57 snaps (74%), 22 routes on 32 Josh Allen dropbacks (69%). Will move needle when on field.
Risk/reward because maybe decoy but starting Malik Nabers wherever I have him after active.
items.why: Active despite uncertainty; decoy risk but start.

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze officially is active today.
Isaiah Likely breakout SZN is well under way.
I'd buy low on Loveland. Preseason take was want as much Bears offense as possible and that hasn't changed.
items.why: Week 1 quiet but buy-low on Bears TE.
